device.name: NaVILA-Bench go2_matterport_vision (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim 4.1 target)

facts.text: The repository is a benchmark framework for evaluating Visual Language Navigation in Isaac Lab
Isaac Sim 4.1.0 and Isaac Lab 1.1.0 are installed separately, and the omni.isaac.vlnce and omni.isaac.matterport extensions are symlinked into the Isaac Lab source tree
The benchmark data and Matterport USD assets are downloaded from Hugging Face into the isaaclab_exts/omni.isaac.vlnce/assets directory
go2_matterport_vision is registered with the external entry point omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and the environment configuration Go2MatterportVisionCfg
The card entry symbol Go2MatterportVisionCfg is defined as a subclass of Go2MatterportBaseCfg
Go2MatterportBaseCfg extends ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg, so the registered environment base is external to the clone
ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg is imported from omni.isaac.lab.envs, the external Isaac Lab package
The Go2 robot is loaded from the external Isaac Lab asset {ISAACLAB_NUCLEUS_DIR}/Robots/Unitree/Go2/go2.usd
The action term is a JointPositionActionCfg over all robot joints (joint_names ['.*'])
The base post-initialization changes the joint-position action scale to 0.25
The simulation step is 0.005 s and the decimation is 4
The episode length is 200000.0 s
The rgbd camera is 512 by 512 and returns rgb and distance_to_image_plane data
The visualization camera is 512 by 512 and returns rgb data
The camera_obs group is the rgb measurement of the rgbd_camera and viz_camera_obs is the rgb measurement of the viz_rgb_camera
The vision configuration declares the observation groups policy, proprio, critic, camera_obs, viz_camera_obs and depth_obs
The policy observation group includes a last-action term
Termination is time_out, an illegal contact of the base above threshold 1.0 or a bad orientation with limit_angle 0.8
The only reward term is a termination penalty of -200.0 on is_terminated
The vision scene uses one environment with 2.5 spacing
The evaluation creates the environment with gym.make(task, cfg=env_cfg, render_mode=None), so the registered task needs an environment configuration object
The evaluation reads camera_obs and viz_camera_obs and takes channel indices 0:3 of each frame
The repository licence is MIT

determinism.notes: reset(seed=...) and cap.world.seed.v1 seed the fake's own random.Random, and its step is deterministic, so one seed repeats a fake trajectory.  The upstream reset is Isaac Sim state (episode start position and rotation, Matterport scene, robot pose), was not run and is not claimed to be reproducible here.

gaps: the fake is an interface stand-in with no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator, sensor or noise model, no robot pose, no Matterport scene and no lidar or height scan; Isaac Sim 4.1.0 and Isaac Lab 1.1.0 (README.md:55-62) are not installed and no simulator run is claimed

the real camera image is 512 x 512 (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:301-307 and :309-315) with rgb and distance data; the fake returns an 8 x 8 x 3 placeholder image (192 values) and does not model depth, the 32-channel lidar (go2_matterport_vision_cfg.py:151-153) or the critic height scan

the upstream observation is a dict of six groups (go2_matterport_vision_cfg.py:133-139); the fake represents policy as the 12 last-action values only, proprio as 6 placeholder base angular-velocity and rpy values only, and camera_obs as the small placeholder image; critic, viz_camera_obs and depth_obs are not represented, and velocity_commands, joint positions and joint velocities are absent

the real action space is built by the external ManagerBasedRLEnv from JointPositionActionCfg (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:125); the fake exposes an unbounded 12-value Box, its 12 is a placeholder for the joint count of the USD asset (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:70), the upstream bounds were not inspected and nothing is clamped

the fake returns reward 0.0 and never terminates or truncates; the upstream reward is a -200.0 termination penalty (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:116-118), the termination terms are time_out, base contact and bad orientation (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:230-245), and the 200000.0 s episode length (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:369) is not modelled
reset returns seeded placeholder values and ignores options; the upstream reset builds an Isaac Sim episode from the R2R data and Matterport assets (README.md:82), which are not present
no snapshot or restore: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state and the fake offers none
the fake was never compared with an Isaac Sim run, and no hardware or real-simulator evidence exists

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime's latch refuses every step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset, and the last observation, tick and episode stay readable
